subject: reasoning
question: In each of the following questions, a group of three numbers/symbols is given in each option. Identify the group that does NOT follow the same pattern as the others.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6e499502a41e1efdddc52555d733ef3470adedbbe91aaa21a98924dacc374d7.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Option 1) A1 : D5 : G9

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91db3cb622ec554638560742660520627e14642e3398066b49b1857fb21ad30.png] 

Option 2) B2 : E6 : H10

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef41bc3309b14de44942b00e0e844d1a8f778a4d286c6c31ea2b3854901de2a2.png] 

Option 3) C3 : F7 : I11

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44d6a3f7de900596b36bde802c217fe47241635465d5d58250869200e791f203.png] 

Option 4) D4 : G8 : K13

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bcfcd354bccf5821f656500198ba58f268ba53a79eea9415d84fd92a690d714.png] 

So, the odd group is **D4 : G8 : K13**.

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 4".**
